dimensions.evidenceA: The devil takes Jesus to the holy city and temple pinnacle.
dimensions.evidenceB: The devil shows the kingdoms and claims authority to give them.
dimensions.label: Second test

dimensions.evidenceA: The kingdoms-and-worship exchange closes the testing before angels serve.
dimensions.evidenceB: The testing ends at the Jerusalem temple. The devil then leaves until another time.
dimensions.label: Closing test

evidence.observation: Matthew places the temple test before the kingdoms-and-worship test.
Luke places the kingdoms-and-worship test before the temple test in Jerusalem.

record.tension: Matthew and Luke preserve the same major tests in a different narrative order.
record.title: Which wilderness test comes second?
